name: CaseSvgStrokeGlyphFillNone
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "svg-stroke-glyph-fill-none" (anatomy). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a STROKE-drawn svg glyph whose computed fill is none (the lucide check: an open path, stroke=currentColor, fill="none" on the svg)
